about: The looks the shot modules take (user, 2026-10-22: 系统需要灵活变体 不能一种风格不同主题视频). The reference teaches the structure (cuts, camera, layers, what is shown, the size and place of the type); the style is chosen per film from its subject, and may vary by chapter within its family. Each style is a skin the modules read (modules.mjs styleTheme -> spec.theme): ground and ink colours, the accent and the mark, the rise and fall colours of a market picture, the house fonts for display / text / accent, the texture over everything, how painted plates are described to image generation, and the camera's temper. The world of each style is the card line's theme of the same family (themes/<theme>.json). Since 2026-10-26 (CONVERGE-20261026 conflict 1) a style is the film's whole look, chosen once in project.json style: the 3D's material (material3d: ground, body, unit, emissive, metal, roughness, light) and the medium laid over the packaging (medium: none, print riso, tube pvm) came over from worlds/*.json, which older projects (project.world) still read. Each style carries the user's verdict (verdict: approved, rejected or untested, with their words; 2026-10-26: the Vol.047 run took a style the user had rejected on 10-20 and showed it to them again). A new film takes an approved style; a rejected one never; an untested one only as a proposal the user judges at the look gate, and their approval there makes it approved.
